title: feat(console): a change on a list is a draft, with Discard and Save (#35955 PR 1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMgJdD9Md5HuS27VZpJByFw)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUr9HRqChVQu82hqdz

Part of #35955 (PR 1 of three: PR 2 saves into a shared view, confirm then publish per ruling 7058616478, after #35932; PR 3 retires the server-side list preference. The card stays open.)

Clause-②: yes (widening) — nine new `console.objectView.draft.*` keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale pack; no key removed or renamed (the retired marker's four keys stay in every pack); `@object-ui/app-shell` is private; `@object-ui/plugin-list` changes only its README (no prop changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表上的排序、筛选、分组、搜索、隐藏列、加列、拖列顺序，改了立刻生效，但不再自动存到「我的个人列表偏好」里：它们现在是**草稿**，只在这个浏览器标签页里。
- 有草稿时，条件行右端出现「放弃」和「保存 ▾」（原来的「已个性化 · 重置」去掉）。手机和窄屏上合成一个「保存 ▾」，菜单里三项：保存到这个视图、另存为我的视图、放弃。
- 「保存 ▾」菜单先写出哪些没存（例如「未保存的改动：排序」）。在自己的个人视图上可以「保存到这个视图」；任何视图上都可以「另存为我的视图」：先起名（默认「原视图名 副本」），存好后切到新视图。存完弹「已保存」，按钮消失，排序 / 筛选标签留着。
- 草稿在点开记录再返回时还在；切到别的视图或对象、或刷新页面就没了，列表回到视图本来的样子。
- 列宽、行高、视图标签的顺序不算草稿，照旧按人记住（在 PR 3 之前仍写服务端同一行）。
- 升级影响：以前自动存进个人偏好里的排序、筛选、搜索、列顺序、隐藏列、加的列从此不再生效，用户打开列表看到的是视图本来的样子。数据本身这次不删（PR 3 清）。
- 这次没做：共享视图上的「保存到这个视图」，以及把显示面板的「布局 / 行颜色」存进视图（「放弃」已能还原它们），两样都在 PR 2。

## What changes

**The draft** — new `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/listDraftStore.ts`. One draft at a time, for one reader, object and view (`listDraftScope`), held in module memory (not React state: the list page unmounts while a record is open as a page). Read through `useListDraft` (`useSyncExternalStore`).

- It holds the sort, the Filter panel's group, the grouping, the search, the column order, the hidden fields and the added fields. A sort is kept as `{ field, order }` (the grid's row ids dropped); a filter group with no condition is no filter.
- `claimListDraft` drops a draft held for another scope when a list takes its seed (another view or object opened). A reload is read once per document (`takeDocumentReload`, the navigation timing's `type === 'reload'`) and counts only when the reloaded address (origin, path, query) is the address the list opens on: a reload of the list's own page ignores its `uf_*` params and starts clean, while a reload of another page leaves an in-app link to a list free to apply its `uf_*` state.
- `listDraftPreference` lays the draft over the stored row in the `ListViewPreference` shape the list relay and the view builders already read, taking only the column widths and the row height from what was stored. A sort, filter, column order, hidden or added column stored by an earlier console is no longer read.

**The writes** (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`). The sort, grouping, filter, search, hidden fields, added fields and column order go to the draft. A column report is split: its order goes to the draft, its widths to `listPrefs.patchView(id, { columnState: { widths } })`, and only when they differ from what is stored. Density and the views' order are unchanged (stored). The list's own "Reset to view default" drops the reset parts from the draft (and the stored row height). The Filter panel's per-browser search cache is no longer written.

**The seed** (`objectViewListUrlState.ts`). The list seeds from the address's `uf_*` state, else from the draft. The parts that light Discard and Save are the parts the list reports, minus density and search, plus `columns` while the draft holds a column order or added fields. `handleResetView` (Discard) drops the draft, strips the list's `uf_*` params and remounts the list; widths and row height stay.

**Discard and Save** — `ListPersonalizedMarker.tsx` → `ListDraftActions.tsx`, in the same `conditionRowEnd` slot (objectstack#35878). Wide face: a ghost **Discard** beside **Save ▾**. Below `@[40rem]/list` (and in the phone chip row, objectstack#35883): one **Save ▾** whose menu also holds Discard. The menu's label names the unsaved parts.

- **Save to this view**: offered on a personal view the reader may update; `handleSaveToPersonalView` as before, now with a "Saved" toast. `buildPersonalViewConfig` (`personalViews.ts`) also appends the draft's added fields as columns.
- **Save as my view**: offered where the reader may create a personal view. It opens `PersonalViewNameDialog` with "<view> copy", builds the view with `buildInPlaceViewConfig` from the draft, saves it, clears the source list's draft and address state, toasts "Saved" and opens the new view.
- No shared-view save yet (PR 2).

**i18n**: `console.objectView.draft.{discard, discardTitle, save, heading, partSeparator, saveToView, saveAsMyView, copyName, saved}` in all ten hand-written packs, zh-Hant regenerated (`pnpm gen:zh-hant`, no diff after). `personalized`, `personalizedHeading`, `resetView` and `resetViewTitle` are no longer drawn and stay in every pack (the objectstack#35684 precedent), so no published key goes away.

**Docs**: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` "A user's list state never writes the view" (heading kept: two READMEs link its anchor) now describes the draft. Platform checklist `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` revision 13: the in-app-navigation restore becomes the record round trip, and the user-scope clause reads that nothing is stored (not loosened: a second account still sees none of the first account's filters).

**Changeset**: `.changeset/35955-list-changes-are-drafts.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch) with the upgrade note.

## Why

Card #35955: everything changed on a list is temporary and applies at once; Discard and Save replace 「Personalized · Reset」; column widths, row height and tab order are never a draft. D1 settled 06:09Z (browser-only, done in PR 3); D2 ruling 7058616478 applies to PR 2.

## Tests

Rewritten to the new premise (each old pin asserted a `ui.list` write that this card retires):

- `ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx` — rewritten (40 cases): a sort, hide, add or filter writes nothing stored and is the draft's; a resize lands as one save, widths only; a drag is the draft's order with its widths stored; stored sort, filters, hidden and added fields from an earlier console no longer apply; Discard writes nothing and keeps widths and density; the view's defaults (`viewDefaults`) are unchanged; "Reset to view default" drops the draft part; a width change writes only when it changes; the Manage Views drag and the view editor's `/meta/view` write unchanged.
- `ObjectView.listPersonalized-28950.test.tsx` — the marker block rewritten for Discard and Save (parts named in the menu, both faces, Discard drops the draft and the `uf_*` params, widths stay).
- `ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` — the save paths use the new testids and toast; new case for Save as my view (name defaults to "View 1 copy", nothing written before the name, the new view opens, the source draft is gone).
- `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.ufViewSwitch-11992.test.tsx` — seeds moved from the stored row to the draft; new pins that stored sort, filter, search and hidden fields no longer apply; a view switch opens clean.
- `consoleListStateWall-12418.test.tsx` — under the walled posture a sort and a hide write nothing; the drag and the density still land as one preference write each.
- `view-filter-fold.ratchet.test.ts`, `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly.test.ts` — the source regexes follow the draft writes.
- `ObjectView.listPageInUrl-30850.test.tsx` — resets the draft between cases (one case's search leaked into the next).

Local runs: `@object-ui/app-shell` full suite 22097 tests, 4 failed on the first run (the two files above, both old premises), both files re-run green after the fix (9/9); `@object-ui/i18n` 1957 passed; app-shell `tsc --noEmit` clean; `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` clean (no new key reported); `check:platform-checklist` OK; eslint on the changed sources 0 errors; `overlap-check` clean against main and 6 open PRs.

## Verification

Browser, showcase (`os dev --seed-admin --fresh`), console from this branch's `ui/` (vite), Chromium 1440×900 and iPhone 13. Screenshots and probe scripts: project folder `build-seat1/35955/shots/`.

| Reading | Result |
|---|---|
| All Tasks opened | no Discard / Save |
| Sort by Title through the condition row | applies at once, `uf__sort` in the address, Discard + Save ▾ drawn; menu "Unsaved changes: Sort · Save as my view" (shared view: no Save to this view) |
| Open a record, browser Back | sort still on, Discard + Save still drawn |
| Reload | list opens as the view declares it, no `uf_*`, no buttons |
| Save as my view | name defaults to "All Tasks copy"; after Save the new personal view opens, toast "Saved", buttons gone, the sort chip stays |
| On that personal view, Filter Status = Done, Save → Save to this view | menu "Unsaved changes: Filters · Save to this view · Save as my view"; toast "Saved"; after a reload the view opens with the filter (2 rows) |
| Remove the saved filter chip, then Discard | 10 rows → Discard → back to the view's 2 rows, no buttons |
| Phone (iPhone 13), a sort | only the compact Save ▾ is visible; its menu: "Unsaved changes: Sort · Save as my view · Discard" |
| Preference writes on the wire during the whole run | none to `ui.list.*` (only the recent-items and app rows); one `PATCH sys_personal_view/<id>` for Save to this view |

## Review round 1 (L1-b REWORK 7060128462, L2 PASS + F1) → fe3589d6

- **M1** `takeDocumentReload(currentHref?)` counts a reload only when the reloaded address (origin, path, query) is the address the list opens on; still read once per document. A reload of the AI chat page followed by an answer's in-app list link now applies the link's `uf__filter`. Three new cases in `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx` (reload of the list itself strips `uf_*`; reload elsewhere then in-app link applies the filter; first load applies it). Ablation: with the address check forced true, the "reload elsewhere" case fails.
- **Merge main** at 19cf1365 (seat asked, K=18): no conflicts; the files both sides touched are the 11 locale packs and `records-forms.json` (other items). After the merge: 204 affected test files 2832/2832 (13 skipped), `check:platform-checklist` OK, zh-Hant regen identical, `overlap-check` clean. L2 nit G1 (the old reload rule in What changes) is fixed in this body.
- **S1** `ListDraftActions`: with no save offered, the narrow face is a plain Discard (no Save ▾). New `ListDraftActions.noSave-35955.test.tsx` (2 cases).
- **S2** `plugin-list/README.md` (added fields are part of the draft; changeset now lists `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch for the README) and the stale "Reset to view" / 「Personalized」 comments in `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `objectViewListUrlState.ts`, `ObjectView.tsx`.
- **S3** `records-forms.grid-personalization` revision 9: steps[2], steps[6], acceptance[0] say a column order is a draft and does not come back after a reload; widths and row height still must.
- **N1** changeset: "Nothing stored is deleted; a later column-width change rewrites that row's column state with the widths alone."
- **N2** one `canCreatePersonalView` test shared by Save as my view and the switcher's create card (adds `listReadable` and `!viewAccess.refusal` to Save as my view).
- **N3 / F1** `ListDraft.viewType` / `rowColor` and the module header say they are written from PR 2; the PR 2 gap line above names the record round trip.
- Local: the 8 affected files 138/138; app-shell `tsc` clean; eslint on every changed app-shell file 0 errors; `check:test-source-alias`, `check:platform-checklist`, `overlap-check` clean. Docs `views.mdx`: reload of the list's page drops the draft; an in-app link's state applies.

## Known gaps (for the seat)

- Save does not keep layout or row colour yet, and they do not survive opening a record as a page and coming back (the draft does not hold them yet); PR2
- **Widths, row height and the views' order still go to the server-side row until PR 3** (seat item 6). PR 3 moves them to the browser and clears the stored rows.

Read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/listDraftStore.ts`, then the writes in `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (search `listDraft.patch`) and the seed in `objectViewListUrlState.ts`.

Two-minute check: open any object list, sort by a column (Discard and Save appear), open a record and press Back (still there), reload (gone); sort again, Save → Save as my view, accept the name (the new view opens with the sort, "Saved").
